title: Insurance Act
verified_how: Register index entry 'Insurance Act', consolidation date June 17, 2022. Cover page prints 'INSURANCE ACT / RSNWT 1988,c.I-4' (French: 'LOI SUR LES ASSURANCES / LRTN-O 1988, ch. I-4'), amended from RSNWT 1988,c.1(Supp.) (in force April 21, 1989; SI-014-89) onward. Standard office-consolidation notice; not marked repealed.
notes: Contains the statutory conditions for fire, automobile, life, accident and sickness insurance, proof-of-loss and claims-payment timelines, and insurer licensing. Motor-vehicle third-party liability requirements sit alongside it in the Motor Vehicles Act. Work injury compensation is separate, under the Workers' Compensation Act, S.N.W.T. 2007, c.21.
